description: 1000 procedural situations feeding only dogfood + observed result + observation boundary/artifact identity into the reverse half.

public.dogfood:
Situation S0001. Produce the requested result exactly; do not substitute adjacent proxy success.
- Required user state must survive a full reload and reconstruct identically.
- Exported project data must round-trip back into the application without losing supported fields.
- The same seed and inputs must reproduce the same world result without unrelated generators perturbing it.
- No proxy metric may promote a result when the requested observable consequence is still unverified or visibly wrong.
public.result:
Export followed by import reproduces all supported project fields exactly.
Reload restores only part of the state and silently drops fields.
Repeated runs with the same seed and inputs reproduce identical world results, and adding unrelated generators does not perturb existing streams.
Promotion stays blocked whenever the required observable consequence is unverified, even if lower-level proxy metrics pass.
public.evidence_boundary: reload/state behavior only; this observation cannot prove properties outside that modality.
